description: Regulated 3.3V power output stage. AMS1117-3.3 regulates a 5V input down to 3.3V, and TPS3703 supervises the 3.3V rail directly through its VDD/SENSE connection. The supervisor provides an open-drain RESET/POWER_GOOD style output, with manual reset left unused in a legal inactive configuration.

verification_assertions.desc: Ground unification: AMS1117 and TPS3703 must share one common ground net.
3.3V domain unification: AMS1117 regulated output must directly power TPS3703 VDD and be monitored through TPS3703 SENSE.
Critical net isolation: 5V input, 3.3V rail, GND, and RESET output must all reside on mutually distinct nets.
Unified ground net must carry Ground electrical attribute.
5V input rail feeding AMS1117 must carry Power electrical attribute.
3.3V output rail generated by AMS1117 must carry Power electrical attribute.
TPS3703 RESET is an open-drain output and must have an external pull-up resistor to the logic supply rail.
Unused TPS3703 manual reset pin is legal either floating or tied to VDD.
AMS1117 input rail must have a bypass capacitor to ground.
The unified 3.3V rail must have an output/decoupling capacitor to ground.
